result:
Confirmed: fixing this correctly requires widening the `onAutoUpdaterResult` signature to `AutoUpdaterResult | null` all the way up the chain (`PromptInputFooter.tsx`, `PromptInput.tsx`), since the real handler is `setAutoUpdaterResult` from `useState<AutoUpdaterResult | null>`. Fixing only `Notifications.tsx` either creates the identical error at a different line within the same file, or requires a runtime-behavior-changing guard/silencer — both out of scope for a single-file, non-silencing edit. Skipping per the rules.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/repl/src/components/PromptInput/Notifications.tsx",
 "edits": [],
 "patterns": [],
 "fixes": [],
 "skipped": ["src/packages/repl/src/components/PromptInput/Notifications.tsx(390,11): error TS2322: onAutoUpdaterResult is typed (result: AutoUpdaterResult) => void in this file's Props and NotificationContent params, but AutoUpdaterWrapper genuinely requires (result: AutoUpdaterResult | null) => void — the real handler is REPLView.tsx's setAutoUpdaterResult from useState<AutoUpdaterResult | null>(null). Fixing correctly means widening the signature through PromptInputFooter.tsx and PromptInput.tsx too (both outside this item's ARCHIVO); narrowing only here just moves the same TS2322 to line 238 within this file, or forces a null-guard/assertion that would either change runtime behavior or silence the error."]}
```
